title: Integration of multi-omics and network toxicology reveals TLR4-mediated nephrotoxicity induced by arecoline.
authors: Yuan, Jixiang; Chen, Lichen; Wang, Xilong; Jiang, Zhibin; Jin, Dian; Bai, Yongheng; Pan, Xiaodong; Li, Yifu; Lin, Feihong; Cai, Yong
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用网络毒理学、分子对接和MD模拟探究槟榔碱与TLR4蛋白的相互作用及肾毒性机制，对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法聚焦于TF-DNA结合，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Arecoline, the primary alkaloid in areca nut, induces renal injury, yet its underlying molecular mechanisms remain poorly understood. This study aimed to identify arecoline's molecular targets and elucidate the subsequent pathological signaling cascade in renal cells. METHODS: We integrated network toxicology, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to predict arecoline's targets. In vitro validation in human kidney (HK-2) cells assessed target engagement via a cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA). Downstream signaling, inflammatory, and fibrotic markers were evaluated using Western blotting, ELISA, and immunofluorescence. RESULTS: Computational models predicted a stable arecoline-Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4) complex. CETSA demonstrated that arecoline enhanced TLR4 thermal stability in HK-2 cells, strongly indicating target engagement. This binding activated the PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. Consequently, arecoline induced NF-kappaB-dependent upregulation of pro-inflammatory cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-1beta), elevated the renal injury marker KIM-1, and promoted the accumulation of fibrotic proteins (alpha-SMA, Collagen III). CONCLUSIONS: Arecoline instigates nephrotoxicity by targeting TLR4 and activating the PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB axis, driving an inflammatory and fibrotic phenotype in renal tubular cells. The arecoline-TLR4 interaction represents a critical event in areca nut-associated nephropathy, offering a novel therapeutic target.
abstract_zh: 背景：槟榔碱（Arecoline）是槟榔中的主要生物碱，可诱导肾损伤，但其潜在分子机制仍知之甚少。本研究旨在识别槟榔碱的分子靶点，并阐明其在肾细胞中随后的病理信号级联反应。方法：我们整合了网络毒理学、分子对接和分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟来预测槟榔碱的靶点。在人肾（HK-2）细胞中进行体外验证，通过细胞热位移分析（CETSA）评估靶点结合。下游信号、炎症和纤维化标志物通过Western blotting、ELISA和免疫荧光进行评估。结果：计算模型预测了稳定的槟榔碱- Toll样受体4（Toll-like receptor 4, TLR4）复合物。CETSA表明，槟榔碱增强了HK-2细胞中TLR4的热稳定性，强烈提示靶点结合。该结合激活了PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB信号通路。因此，槟榔碱诱导NF-kappaB依赖性的促炎细胞因子（TNF-alpha、IL-6、IL-1beta）上调，升高肾损伤标志物KIM-1，并促进纤维化蛋白（alpha-SMA、Collagen III）的积累。结论：槟榔碱通过靶向TLR4并激活PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB轴，驱动肾小管细胞的炎症和纤维化表型，从而引发肾毒性。槟榔碱-TLR4相互作用是槟榔相关肾病中的关键事件，提供了新的治疗靶点。
